title: kithctl watch: RAW_MIGRATIONS list requires manual sync with MIGRATIONS table
description: kith-store/src/lib.rs introduces RAW_MIGRATIONS: &[u32] = &[16] — a separate list of migration versions that run without a transaction. Nothing enforces that every entry in RAW_MIGRATIONS is also in MIGRATIONS. A future contributor adding a V20 that needs raw execution must remember to add it to both lists. Missing it means V20 runs inside a transaction, silently failing if it contains PRAGMA foreign_keys (the documented reason for the raw path). A compile-time check (e.g. a const assertion that verifies every RAW_MIGRATIONS entry is a valid MIGRATIONS version) would catch this. Alternatively, store the raw flag as part of the MIGRATIONS tuple.
